# OwnResume

> OwnResume is a free, open, browser-based AI resume builder. It creates ATS-friendly,
> recruiter-ready resumes and CVs with 8 professional templates, a live A4 preview,
> PDF import and one-click PDF export. No account is required and all resume data is
> stored locally in the user's browser — nothing is uploaded to a server.

URL: https://getownresume.netlify.app/
Language: English
Price: Free (no account, no credit card)
Platform: Any modern web browser (desktop, tablet, mobile)

## What it does

- Build a resume or CV from a guided form: personal info, summary, social profiles,
  experience, projects, education, skills, interests, certifications and languages.
- Choose from 8 professional layouts: Classic, Modern Sidebar, Bold Header, Pikachu
  (right sidebar), Minimal, Creative Grid, Professional Split and Elegant Minimal.
- Set an accent colour so the resume matches a personal brand.
- Preview the exact A4 page live while editing, with edit / split / preview modes.
- Import an existing resume from a text-based PDF or from a JSON backup.
- Export a pixel-accurate PDF through the browser print pipeline (A4, no margins).
- Switch between light and dark themes; the interface is fully responsive.

## Privacy

Resume content is saved in the browser's localStorage on the user's own device.
There is no backend, no tracking of resume content, and no upload of personal data.
Exported JSON files are the user's own portable backup.

## ATS compatibility

All templates output real, selectable text with conventional section headings, so
applicant tracking systems can parse name, contact details, experience, education
and skills. Resumes are not exported as images.

## Who it is for

Job seekers, students, career switchers, freelancers and professionals who need a
clean, modern, ATS-friendly resume quickly and without paying a subscription.

## Frequently asked questions

### Is OwnResume free?
Yes. Every template and export option is unlocked, with no sign-up and no trial limits.

### Where is my data stored?
Locally in the user's browser only. Nothing is sent to a server.

### Can I import an existing resume?
Yes — text-based PDFs are parsed into the form, and JSON backups can be restored.
Image-only scanned PDFs cannot be read.

### Are the templates ATS-friendly?
Yes. They export real text with standard section headings.

### Do I need an account to download my resume?
No. You can download a PDF without creating an account.
